correctness.rationale: Exact column-kernel independence gives h(A)=sum prefix nullities; a one-step rank-nullity extension has jump multiplicity q^(j-1-k) and no-jump multiplicity q^j-q^(j-1-k). Fixed rank-stratum affine/vector bundle geometry proves each stratum irreducible of dimension m-r(r+1)/2+sum(n-p+1), and unique initial-segment maxima yield m+floor(n^2/4), with one or two top components. Verified explicit enumeration and checker path independently in nine finite cases and symbolic leading degrees n<=40; checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The annihilator-size spectrum is a natural multiplicity refinement of zero-product relations and finite triangular ring graph out-neighborhoods, for all n and all finite fields. The exact geometric dimension and parity-dependent number of top-dimensional irreducible components is an additional nontrivial structural invariant inaccessible from a single fixed-n edge count. The rank-jump derivation explains rather than merely tabulates the phenomenon.
